_readme: Where fetch_lake_levels.py gets daily water-surface elevation for each reservoir. Keys match water names in stocking_data_clean.json (or extra_waters.json).
source  - usgs  : USGS NWIS daily values (waterservices.usgs.gov). id = site number. param 62614 = elevation ft NGVD29, 00054 = storage acre-ft.
usbr  : Bureau of Reclamation UC hydrodata daily CSV (usbr.gov/uc/water/hydrodata/reservoir_data/<id>/csv/49.csv = pool elevation).
usace : Army Corps CDA API, 15-minute series aggregated to a daily value. id = timeseries id (tsid).
unit    - ft (elevation) or ac-ft (storage, only where no elevation series exists).
full_pool_ft - optional. Leave blank unless taken from the operating agency; the chart works without it.
label   - how the operating agency names the site, for the source credit.
